# GadgetFont <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GadgetFont:Int32 gadget:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of the gadget. |

**Returns:** A font handle, or 0 if it uses the default font.

## Description

Gives the font a gadget is drawn with. The official help lists the command as undocumented.
